DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅からこちらへ来る途中、交差点の信号が黄色く点滅していました。いつもと違うので、お知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段と違う黄色点滅を見たことを窓口へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On my way here from the station, the traffic light at an intersection was flashing yellow. That is different from usual, so I wanted to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the counter staff you saw an unusual flashing yellow light. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 交差点の名前は分かりますか。どちら側からご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the intersection's name? From which side did you see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は分かりません。駅を背にして進んだ先で、右側に青い看板の店があります。地図なら場所を示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交差点名が不明なため進行方向と店の目印で地図提示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't know its name. Going away from the station, there is a shop with a blue sign on the right. I can show you the location on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Since you don't know the intersection's name, explain your direction of travel and the shop landmark, and ask to show it on a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、この地図でお示しください。点滅していたのは車用の信号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please point it out on this map. Was it a traffic light for vehicles that was flashing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここです。駅から来る車に向いた信号です。反対側や歩行者用の表示までは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で位置と車用信号の向きを示し未観察の表示と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. It was the light facing cars coming from the station. I haven't checked the lights on the opposite side or the pedestrian signals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location and direction of the vehicle signal on the map, distinguishing them from signals you did not observe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認された範囲を記録します。事故や、けがをされた方は見かけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record what you confirmed. Did you see an accident or anyone injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私が通った時には見かけませんでした。車道に出て車を止めたほうがいいか迷いましたが、何もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事故未目撃と交通整理をしていないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I didn't see any when I passed. I wondered whether I should step into the road and stop the cars, but I haven't done anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw no accident and have not directed traffic. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で交通整理をしようとせず、安全な場所にいてください。通った時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please stay somewhere safe and don't try to direct traffic yourself. What time did you pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十五分ほど前です。帰りも車道には出ません。連絡が必要なら、私の電話番号をこちらに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察時刻と安全な帰路を伝え連絡先を提供する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: About fifteen minutes ago. I won't step into the road on my way back either. If you need to contact me, I'll write my phone number here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State when you observed it, explain you will return safely, and offer your contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と、十五分ほど前にご覧になった信号の状態を担当へ伝えます。ご連絡先もお預かりしました。お知らせいただき、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge the location and the signal's condition as you saw it about fifteen minutes ago. We have your contact details too. Thank you for reporting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類の発送ですね。ご希望の送り方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're sending documents, correct? Do you have a preferred mailing method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出した証拠を会社に見せたいです。レシートがあれば、届いた証拠にもなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付控えが到着証拠か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to show my company proof that I sent them. Would a receipt also prove they arrived?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the acceptance receipt proves arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の控えで発送は確認できますが、配達されたこととは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The acceptance receipt confirms dispatch, but that is separate from proof of delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 区別する必要がありますね。募集案内には「発送日が分かる控え」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送日控えの指定を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I need to distinguish the two. The recruitment notice says 'a receipt showing the dispatch date.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read out the requirement for a receipt showing the dispatch date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その条件に合う控えが残る方法を確認しましょう。期限の欄はどう書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check a mailing method that leaves a receipt meeting that condition. What does the deadline section say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「必着」です。発送日だけ合っていても足りないですね。今日は出せても期限に届くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必着条件に気付き到着見込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says 'must arrive by the deadline.' Just having the right dispatch date isn't enough. Even if I can send it today, I want to check whether it will arrive in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recognize the arrival deadline and ask about the expected arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着までの目安をご案内します。ただし、到着日を必ずお約束できるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can give you an estimated delivery time. However, we cannot guarantee a specific arrival date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社には発送控えを残す方法と、到着が遅れる場合の扱いを先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保証範囲を理解し提出先へ遅延扱いも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll first ask the company about a method that provides a dispatch receipt and how they handle late arrivals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the limits of the guarantee and also check with the recipient how delays are handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送り方の案内はこちらです。会社へ確認してから選ばれても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is information on mailing methods. You can choose after checking with the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ発送せず、控えの条件と必着の扱いを会社へ確認します。その回答で送り方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送前に会社条件を確かめ方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't send it yet. I'll check the receipt requirements and the arrival deadline rules with the company, then choose a mailing method based on their answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the company's conditions before sending and decide on a method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では書類はお返しします。確認後、宛先と希望の方法をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll return your documents, then. Once you have checked, tell us the address and your preferred method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を作る目的は、旅行の費用の管理と伺いましたがよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We understand you want to open an account to manage travel expenses. Is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行ではありません。こちらで働き始めて、給与を受け取るためです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行ではなく給与受取目的と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's not for travel. I'm starting work here and need it to receive my salary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the purpose: receiving salary, not travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行の方の説明と違いましたね。お勤め先について確認できる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's different from your companion's explanation. Do you have anything that confirms your employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 採用の案内があります。まだ初出勤前なので、もう勤務しているとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採用資料を示し勤務開始前と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my offer letter. My first day hasn't happened yet, so I can't say I'm already working there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your recruitment documents and distinguish this from having already started work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務開始前という状況ですね。その事実で必要な確認を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you haven't started work yet. We'll proceed with the necessary checks based on that fact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。口座が必ず作れるとは考えていません。今の状況で必要な書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開設保証を求めず必要資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I don't assume I will definitely be able to open an account. Please tell me what documents are needed for my current situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the required documents without seeking a guarantee that the account will be opened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込みの確認書類と、お客様の状況に応じた案内をします。ご本人の書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the application verification documents and provide guidance for your situation. Do you have your own documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。同行者には分からない言葉を訳してもらいますが、目的や勤務状況は私が答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳支援を残し目的と勤務は本人回答にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. My companion will translate words I don't understand, but I will answer questions about my purpose and employment status myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep interpreting assistance while answering personally about the purpose and employment status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように確認しましょう。採用案内の内容も、ご本人と一緒に拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's confirm things that way. We'll also examine the offer letter together with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 給与受取の希望と、初出勤はまだという二点を伝えます。必要な確認に沿って申込みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望と現在状態を正確に示して受付する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain both that I want to receive my salary and that I haven't had my first workday yet. I'll discuss the application following the required checks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your intention and current status accurately when applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人の書類から確認します。結果を約束する前に、現在の状況を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll begin by checking your own documents. Before promising any outcome, let's clarify your current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 魚の表示について、何かお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the fish label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「解凍」とあります。もう準備が済んでいて、そのまま食べられるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 解凍表示を即食可能と解釈し質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 'thawed.' Does that mean it has already been prepared and can be eaten as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether 'thawed' means ready to eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 解凍品であることと、生で食べられることは別です。この商品には加熱用とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Being thawed and being suitable for eating raw are different things. This product is labeled 'for cooking.'

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「加熱用」を見落としました。今日は火を使わずに食べられる物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 加熱表示の見落しと非加熱食希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed 'for cooking.' Today I'm looking for something I can eat without using heat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you missed the cooking label and want food that needs no heating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、加熱が必要なこちらの商品はご希望に合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, this product, which requires cooking, doesn't meet your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかの表示も見たいです。お刺身の売場なら、どれでも同じように持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 刺身売場の商品条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check the other labels too. Can I take home any item from the sashimi section in the same way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for products in the sashimi section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品ごとの保存方法と期限を確認してください。お持ち帰りまで時間はかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check each product's storage instructions and use-by date. Will it take you long to get it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 寄り道で二時間ほどかかります。今日は冷蔵が必要な魚を買うのはやめて、帰る時に選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持歩二時間を理由に冷蔵魚の購入を延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be making a stop, so about two hours. I'll hold off buying fish that needs refrigeration now and choose some when I'm heading home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Postpone buying refrigerated fish because you would carry it around for two hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、帰りに保存方法も含めてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please consider the storage instructions too when choosing on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この加熱用の商品は戻します。解凍という言葉だけで食べ方を判断せず、帰りに表示を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 加熱品を戻し食べ方と保存表示を帰りに確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put this cooking-only product back. I won't judge how to eat it just from the word 'thawed'; I'll check the labels again on my way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put back the cooking-only product and check preparation and storage labels on your way home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品は元の冷蔵売場へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please return it to its original refrigerated display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは体験イベントの受付列です。お申し込みはお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the registration line for the hands-on event. Have you applied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遊具の順番だと思って並びました。申込みはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊具列と誤認し未申込を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this was the line for the play equipment. I haven't applied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook this for the play-equipment line and haven't applied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遊具の入口は別です。こちらの体験は参加受付を確認しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The entrance to the play equipment is separate. Here we check registrations for this activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもがこの作業をやりたいと言っています。当日、空きがあれば参加できるか聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子の希望で当日空きを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child says they want to try this activity. May I ask whether we can join today if there is a vacancy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about same-day vacancies because your child wants to join. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に空きを確認できます。ただ、今の列は予約済みの方の受付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can ask the person in charge about availability. But this line is for people who have already booked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列に並んだままではなく、空きの確認を別にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約列から分けて空き確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check availability separately rather than stay in this line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check availability separately from the reservation line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では担当者に確認します。今は当日参加の枠がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. There are currently no places for same-day participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。参加できると子どもに言ってしまったので、私から説明します。通常の遊具は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 満員を受け子へ説明し通常遊具可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I already told my child they could join, so I'll explain it myself. Can we use the regular play equipment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept that it is full, explain it to your child, and ask whether regular play equipment is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通常の遊具は別の案内です。入口と利用の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The regular play equipment has separate guidance. Please check the entrance and usage signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はイベントを見送ります。子どもに説明して、遊具の入口で案内を読んでから遊びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体験を見送り表示確認後通常遊具へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll skip the event today. I'll explain to my child, read the instructions at the play-equipment entrance, and then we will play.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Skip the activity and move to the regular play equipment after checking the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 遊具の入口はあちらです。イベント受付の列から出て、通路を通ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The play-equipment entrance is over there. Please leave the event registration line and follow the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換先をお探しですか。案内の画面を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your transfer? Please show me the directions on your screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この駅名のホームが見つかりません。アプリでは、ここで乗換になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アプリの乗換駅ホームが見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find a platform with this station name. The app says to change here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because you cannot find the platform for the app's transfer station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面には徒歩の区間がありますね。こちらは別の駅へ歩く経路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The screen includes a walking section. This route takes you on foot to a different station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ駅の別ホームだと思いました。スーツケースがあるので、階段の多い道は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別駅徒歩と理解し荷物と階段回避を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was another platform in the same station. I have a suitcase, so I'd like to avoid routes with lots of stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the walk to another station and explain your luggage and wish to avoid stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 徒歩経路の設備は、こちらで全部確認できません。別の経路もお調べになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't confirm all the facilities along the walking route here. Could you look up another route too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面に徒歩なしの経路もあります。少し遅く着きますが、こちらの乗換ならこの駅から出発できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩なしの別経路の出発駅を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is also a route without walking on the screen. It arrives a little later, but with this transfer option, can I start from this station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the departure station for another route that requires no walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最初の列車はこの駅からです。次の乗換駅と時刻もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The first train leaves from this station. Please also check your next transfer station and the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらを選びます。待合せ相手へ到着が遅くなると連絡してから、ホームへ向かいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅い経路を選び相手への到着連絡をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose this route. I'd like to tell the person I'm meeting that I'll arrive late before heading to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the later route and notify the person you are meeting of your arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。最初の列車の行先表示はこちらで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. You can check the first train's destination display here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡しました。別駅まで歩く案内は使わず、こちらの列車で次の乗換駅へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡後徒歩移動案をやめ最初の列車を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've contacted them. I won't use the directions involving a walk to another station; I'll take this train to the next transfer station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After making contact, discard the walking option and settle on the first train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この列車の行先と発車案内を確認してお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check this train's destination and departure information before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の発行ですね。必要な種類と部数をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You need a certificate issued, correct? Please tell me the type and number of copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社用に二部お願いします。紙を渡すのと、写真を送るのに一部ずつ必要だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画像用と紙用を別原本二部と思って頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two copies for my company, please. I thought I'd need one to hand over on paper and another to photograph and send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two originals, thinking separate originals are needed for the image and paper submissions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真用に別の原本が必要かは、提出先の指定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the recipient's requirements to see whether a separate original is needed for the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「先に画像、後で原本一部」とあります。同じ一部を撮って提出すればよいか、会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内を読み同一原本利用を会社へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say 'image first, one original later.' I'll ask the company whether I can photograph and submit the same copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the submission instructions and ask the company whether the same original can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。証明書の種類も、その案内に書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Do those instructions also state the type of certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名称はこの部分です。ただ、世帯全員ではなく本人だけと指定されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人だけの指定と証明名称を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name is here. But they specify just me, not everyone in the household.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the certificate name and the requirement for your details only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容で必要な証明書を確認します。部数はまだ確定せずお待ちしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the necessary certificate based on that. Let's wait before finalizing the number of copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社から返事が来ました。同じ原本を画像で送って、後で郵送するそうです。一部に変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社回答で二部から一部に訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company has replied. They say to send an image of the same original, then mail it later. I'll change the request to one copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change from two copies to one based on the company's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一部ですね。申請の内容を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: One copy, then. Let's check the application details together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人分を一部でお願いします。受け取ったら画像を送り、その原本を会社へ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人分一部と画像後原本提出の順序を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: One copy for just me, please. Once I receive it, I'll send an image and then submit that original to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one copy for yourself and the sequence of image first, original afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で受付します。記載事項と本人確認の書類を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll accept the application on that basis. Please let us check the entries and your identification documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の飲酒の欄を確認します。この数字は一回に飲む量ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'd like to check the alcohol section on your medical questionnaire. Is this number the amount you drink on one occasion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 週の合計を書きました。一回の量を書く欄だとは気付きませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 週合計を一回量欄に書いたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my weekly total. I didn't realize the field was for the amount on one occasion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the weekly total entered in the per-occasion amount field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 頻度と一回の量を分けて伺います。週に何日ほどですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about frequency and amount per occasion separately. About how many days a week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二日くらいです。その日に同じ量を飲むとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 週頻度と一回量の変動を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About two days. I don't necessarily drink the same amount on those days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the weekly frequency and variation in the amount per occasion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 普段の量と、多く飲む日の量が分かれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me your usual amount and the amount on days when you drink more, if you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普段はこの缶一本です。多い日は二本です。缶の大きさは写真で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 普段と多い日の量を缶写真で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Usually one can like this. On heavier days, two cans. You can check the can size in this photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use a photo of the can to show your usual and heavier-day amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。今週だけのことではなく、普段の様子でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me see the photo. Is that your usual pattern, rather than just this week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普段のことです。今週は飲んでいませんが、それだけを見て「飲まない」とは書かないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今週と普段を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's my usual pattern. I haven't drunk this week, but I shouldn't write 'don't drink' based only on that, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish this week from your usual habits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。普段の頻度と量を記録しましょう。今週飲んでいないことも補足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Let's record your usual frequency and amount, adding that you haven't drunk this week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 週二日、普段一本、多い日は二本と直します。今週は飲んでいないことも担当の方へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 頻度と量を訂正し今週の補足も依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll correct it to two days a week, usually one can and two on heavier days. Please also tell the person in charge that I haven't drunk this week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the frequency and amount, and ask to add the information about this week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を記録します。ほかの欄も単位が分かりにくければ、ご提出前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record that. If the units in other fields are unclear too, please ask before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちになった写真についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss the photo you brought, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、駐車場の入口を撮った写真です。車同士の接触について調べていると聞いたので、参考になるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車場写真が接触の調査に役立つか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took this photo of the parking-lot entrance yesterday. I heard you are investigating contact between cars, so I'd like you to see whether it could help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a parking-lot photo might help the investigation into contact between cars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影した場面で、接触そのものをご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you see the actual contact in the scene you photographed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ぶつかった瞬間は見ていません。音がした後に入口のほうを撮りました。写真に二台の車が写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 接触瞬間は未目撃で音の後の二台を撮ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't see the moment they collided. I photographed the entrance after hearing a sound. There are two cars in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not witness the contact itself and photographed two cars after a sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯も一緒に伺います。写真の元のデータは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask about those circumstances too. Do you still have the original photo data?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スマホに残っています。見やすくするため切り抜いた物もありますが、元の写真を消してはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切抜き版と保存済み原本を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's on my phone. I also have a cropped version to make it easier to see, but I haven't deleted the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the cropped version from the preserved original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず元の写真と撮影時刻を確認します。写真の提供方法は、担当者からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: First we'll check the original photo and the time it was taken. The person in charge will explain how to provide the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。ほかには家族の私用写真もあるので、スマホを丸ごと渡す前に、必要な写真だけを示す方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端末内の私用写真を理由に必要資料のみの提供方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. There are also private family photos on my phone, so before I hand over the whole device, please tell me how to show only the necessary photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Because there are private photos on the device, ask how to provide only the necessary material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。今ここで、ご自身の操作で元の一枚を表示できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge your preference. Can you operate your phone yourself now and display that one original photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示しました。こちらが切り抜く前の写真です。音の後に撮ったことも伝え、送る方法を担当の方と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本一枚を表示し撮影経緯と提出方法を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've opened it. This is the photo before cropping. I'll also explain that it was taken after the sound and agree with the person in charge on how to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Display the one original and confirm the circumstances and submission method with the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の一枚と撮影の経緯を確認する相談として承りました。端末はお手元に持ったまま、担当者の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted your request to check the one original photo and the circumstances in which you took it. Please keep the device with you and wait for the staff member's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の中身を確認します。どのような物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check the contents of your parcel. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 服です。あ、充電できる小さなライトも一緒に入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 衣類以外の充電ライトも申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Clothes. Oh, I also put in a small rechargeable light.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare the rechargeable light as well as the clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電池を含む物について確認が必要です。ライトの電池の種類は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check items containing batteries. Do you know what type of battery the light uses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。箱の説明書も荷物に入れたので、開けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電池種類不明と同梱説明書の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't know. I put the instruction leaflet from the box in the parcel too, so I'd like to open it and look.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the battery type is unknown and ask to check the enclosed instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明書と商品の表示を確認しましょう。電池が外れるかなども伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the instructions and the product label. We'll also ask whether the battery can be removed, among other things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勝手に外して送ると決めず、表示を見て相談します。いまテープを外してもよい場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己判断で外さず開封場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide on my own to remove it and send the parcel; I'll look at the label and consult you. Is there somewhere I may remove the tape now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to open it without deciding yourself to remove the battery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで開けていただけます。内容品が分かるまで発送の手続きは進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can open it here. We won't proceed with shipping until we know the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けました。この表示です。服の下にあるライトも出しますので、取扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現物と表示を出して取扱確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've opened it. Here is the label. I'll also take out the light under the clothes, so please check how it must be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the item and its label and ask for handling confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を基に確認します。梱包の仕方についても、その後ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check based on the label. Then we'll explain how to pack it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発送できる条件を聞いてから包み直します。内容品は服と、この電池入りのライトとして申告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認条件に従う再梱包と正しい内容品申告を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll repack it after hearing the conditions for shipping. I'll declare the contents as clothes and this light containing a battery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will repack according to the checked conditions and accurately declare the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二つで確認します。説明書は確認が終わるまで手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check those two items. Please keep the instructions with you until the check is finished.
